name: HTN Track Benchmarks
description: In this short paper, we outline nine classical benchmarks submitted to the first hierarchical planning track of the International Planning competition in 2020. All of these benchmarks are based on the HDDL language. The choice of the benchmarks was based on a questionnaire sent to the HTN community. They are the following: Barman, Childsnack, Rover, Satellite, Blocksworld, Depots, Gripper, and Hiking. In the rest of the paper we give a short description of these benchmarks. All are totally ordered.
evaluation_method: plan existence/solution quality, plan length, and planner success under benchmark-defined constraints
notes: Comprises several well-known benchmark domains such as Blocksworld, Logistics-like variants, Gripper, Rover, and others. Used in the first hierarchical planning track of IPC 2020.
